Not sure about 3x
But smuggled systems certainly cost 2x-2.5x now (used to be 1.3x-1.7x till early 2026)
Chinese alternatives (Huawei, Cambricon) are much cheaper
Because of this price gap, Chinese hardware is gaining a lot of traction, and Chinese labs are much more eager to adopt them now (HBM production from CXMT  will determine the volume of accelerators shipped)
Zhipu just acquired XCoreSigma to make sure that they can port CUDA kernels as quickly as possible

Here are some of the companies building humanoid robot parts according to UBS

Robot makers:
- China: Unitree, UBTech, AgiBot
- Overseas: Tesla, Boston Dynamics (Hyundai), Figure AI, Agility Robotics

The brain (computing):
- Nvidia, Qualcomm, AMD, Intel
- China: Horizon Robotics, Cambricon, Huawei

The eyes (sensors):
- Sony, Cognex, Keyence
- China: Hesai, RoboSense

The body (batteries):
- CATL, LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, Panasonic

The joints (motors and gears):
- Harmonic Drive Systems, Nabtesco, Schaeffler, Nidec

If you're seeing this im sure you're interested in Robotics
